loops.name: Prompt loop
loops.what: Replays the saved cases nightly on two models, audits the failures, and keeps one targeted prompt fix only when it raises the pass rate.
loops.metric: Median tokens per agent turn, thousands (weekly replay)
loops.note: Target: both models (gpt-6-luna and gpt-6.1-sol) pass at least 90% of saved cases. Last measured: 53% (39 of 73) on Oct 25. Runs nightly until both reach 90%, then weekly.
